description: This file is a complete HTML webpage for a Database Viewer interface. It provides a user interface to browse databases, tables, and view table data with dynamic loading, refresh, and expandable cells functionality. It uses JavaScript to fetch data via API endpoints and render interactive tables and sidebars.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches and displays the list of available databases in the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the list of databases, updating the UI accordingly.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses the list of tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and renders the list of tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Loads and displays data rows for a selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Creates HTML for the data table from fetched data and inserts into DOM.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Renders a table cell, handling large text, nulls, and objects appropriately.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Handles expanding/collapsing a cell's full content when clicked.
